subtasks.title: Repoint ScoutCheckInMatchQuery and ScoutCheckInRollupQuery onto clarity.scout_open_addresses
subtasks.approach: Replace the open_hotlists -> address_links -> latest_address_versions -> latest_addresses chain in BOTH classes with a single read of {$db}.scout_open_addresses, bbox-prefiltered via CROSS JOIN against the existing bbox CTE. Coordinates come from tupleElement(geo, 1)/(geo, 2) — there are no lng/lat columns on the book despite the ticket wording. Keep hotlistOrgFilter duplicated per class (do NOT extract a shared helper), keep the matcher's Direct-wins argMin and ::handle(), keep the rollup's dual-bucket countIf and ::query(cache: true) signature. AC-1 is absolute and includes docblocks. Re-seed the three test files that currently write the old zod fixtures.
subtasks.intended_diffs:
app/Clickhouse/Queries/ScoutCheckInMatchQuery.php — drop `use App\Enums\HotlistStatusEnum;` and the `$zodDb`/`$openStatus` locals (status=Open and length(plate)>3 now live in the chlocal MV, migration 111). Keep PROXIMITY_METERS, BBOX_PAD_DEGREES, hotlistOrgFilter(), the ::handle() signature, and the return mapping unchanged. SQL shape:

WITH position_window AS (
    SELECT
        timestamp_utc,
        tupleElement(geo, 1) AS lng,
        tupleElement(geo, 2) AS lat,
        toStartOfHour(timestamp_utc) AS hour_bucket
    FROM {$db}.sc_positions
    WHERE lower(kit_mapping) = '{$mappingLiteral}'
      AND timestamp_utc >= '{$start}'
      AND timestamp_utc <= '{$end}'
      AND tupleElement(geo, 1) != 0
      AND tupleElement(geo, 2) != 0
),
position_bbox AS (
    SELECT min(lng) - {$pad} AS min_lng, max(lng) + {$pad} AS max_lng,
           min(lat) - {$pad} AS min_lat, max(lat) + {$pad} AS max_lat
    FROM position_window
),
addresses AS (
    SELECT
        book.address_id AS address_id,
        book.hotlist_id AS hotlist_id,
        book.is_staged  AS is_staged,
        tupleElement(book.geo, 1) AS addr_lng,
        tupleElement(book.geo, 2) AS addr_lat
    FROM {$db}.scout_open_addresses book
    CROSS JOIN position_bbox b
    WHERE ({$hotlistOrgFilter})
      AND addr_lng != 0 AND addr_lat != 0
      AND addr_lng BETWEEN b.min_lng AND b.max_lng
      AND addr_lat BETWEEN b.min_lat AND b.max_lat
),
matches AS (
    SELECT a.address_id, a.hotlist_id, a.is_staged,
           p.timestamp_utc, p.hour_bucket, p.lng, p.lat
    FROM position_window p
    INNER JOIN addresses a
        ON geoDistance(p.lng, p.lat, a.addr_lng, a.addr_lat) <= {$proximity}
)
SELECT
    address_id AS out_address_id,
    argMin(hotlist_id, (toUInt8(is_staged), hotlist_id)) AS out_hotlist_id,
    min(is_staged) AS out_is_staged,
    toString(hour_bucket) AS out_hour_bucket,
    tupleElement(argMin((lng, lat), timestamp_utc), 1) AS out_lng,
    tupleElement(argMin((lng, lat), timestamp_utc), 2) AS out_lat,
    toString(min(timestamp_utc)) AS out_matched_at
FROM matches
GROUP BY address_id, hour_bucket

No FINAL on scout_open_addresses (plain MergeTree, one row per (hotlist_id, address_id) per rebuild). No _peerdb_is_deleted, no max(_peerdb_version), no zod table anywhere. The bbox stays a CROSS JOIN against the CTE, NOT four scalar subqueries (AC-2 was measured on the CROSS JOIN form: 1,553,766 vs 1,967,227 read_rows). hotlistOrgFilter's bare org_id/is_staged resolve to the book table — position_bbox has no such columns. If ClickHouse rejects the `addr_lng` alias inside WHERE on this server version, inline the tupleElement() expressions there rather than reverting to scalar subqueries.

Docblock rewrite (AC-1 covers docblocks): the class matches sc_positions against clarity.scout_open_addresses, the fleet-wide open-order book rebuilt every 15 minutes by clarity.scout_open_addresses_mv (chlocal migration 111, DEV-2383). Say explicitly: the book already applies status=Open + length(plate)>3 and the EWKT parse, so this class must not re-apply them; membership can be up to ~15 min + rebuild time stale, which is what the recorder's freshness gate bounds; ORDER BY (org_id, is_staged, hotlist_id, address_id) has no geo prefix, so the bbox prefilter is still load-bearing; Direct-wins argMin is preserved and the rollup deliberately double-counts a shared address.

app/Clickhouse/Queries/ScoutCheckInRollupQuery.php — same swap. Keep scansTable()/FINAL on scans_hot|scans_cold, keep scan_window/scan_bbox naming, keep DISTINCT in matches, keep the two countIf buckets and the array return shape (direct_bucket, staging_bucket) so ClarityScoutDashboardController:254 needs no diff. The addresses CTE selects address_id, is_staged and the two tupleElement coords only (no hotlist_id — the rollup never had it, and adding it would change the DISTINCT grain and break the both-buckets semantics). Drop HotlistStatusEnum + zodDb() here too, and rewrite the docblock's whole 'Address source' section.

tests/Feature/Http/Controllers/Api/ClarityScoutDashboardControllerTest.php — rewrite insertOpenAssignmentAddress() to write a book row (the helper's $geo escape hatch goes away). Per test: test_can_get_check_in_counts and test_check_in_counts_respect_radius / _dedupe_within_hour_bucket / _scoped_to_kit keep their assertions on book rows; test_check_in_counts_ignore_unauthorized_staging_orgs stays as-is in intent (it pins hotlistOrgFilter, which is still platform-side). test_check_in_counts_exclude_non_open_hotlists and test_check_in_counts_exclude_short_plate_hotlists now pin a DIFFERENT thing — the status and plate-length rules moved into the MV — so rewrite each to seed NO book row for that hotlist and assert 0, with a comment naming chlocal migration 111 as the new home of the rule. test_check_in_counts_guard_malformed_geo: the EWKT/NULL/empty cases are gone (the book stores a parsed Point); keep and rewrite the (0,0) case, which the reader still guards via addr_lng != 0 AND addr_lat != 0. tests/Feature/Console/Commands/ScoutRecordCheckInsMemoryTest.php — insertAddress()/insertFarAddresses() move to scout_open_addresses. The far-row generator becomes one INSERT ... subtasks.title: Book-freshness gate in ScoutRecordCheckIns plus the config knob
subtasks.approach: Add a staleness gate to handle() BEFORE acquireConcurrencySlot(): read max(refreshed_at) from the book, and if it is empty/epoch or older than book_freshness_minutes, Log::warning + report(RuntimeException) + return SUCCESS. Probe exceptions are fail-open (see intended_diffs) so the ClickHouse-free and CH-unreachable tests keep their current behavior. Add the config key with no call-site fallback, per config/scout.php's single-default rule.
